newsitem.title: USA: Atlas options Doby George property.
newsitem.headline: Atlas options Doby George property.

text.p: Atlas Corp said Thursday it has granted an option to purchase its Doby George property, located in Elko County, Nev., for a price of $3,000,000.

Atlas said Aquaterre Mineral Development Ltd paid $50,000 for this exclusive option which must be exercised by April 18. Upon exercise of the option, Atlas would receive $1,500,000 and by December 31 an additional $1,450,000 either in cash or common shares of Aquaterre.
Conclusion of this transaction would allow Atlas to fully recover the costs associated with the Doby George project, the company said. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
